description: Search Federal Register documents (final rules, proposed rules, notices, presidential documents) and the passages of their full text. Each passage carries a precise citation (FR page, CFR section and paragraph, and whether it is the rule text, proposed text, presidential text or the agency explanation). Each document carries its status and legal effect from its own dates, and coverage says what has full text. Say what a document requires, authorizes or prohibits only from the passages returned.

parts.description: all | operative | regulatory_text | proposed_regulatory_text | presidential_text | explanation | preamble

query.description: Words to find in the documents and their text

since.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD); only rows on or after this date

status.description: Status prefix, e.g. proposed, final, final: in effect

until.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD); only rows on or before this date

name: federal_register
title: Federal Register: rules, proposals, presidential documents, with full text
